decisions.reason: As a safety shoe line in the firm’s core business that moved from a mention to its own page by 2024, it reflects rising investment and public commitment that management is likely to continue defending.

The comfort insole is a close complement to the footwear business, and its continued presence in 2024 gives management enough basis to attribute modest traction to a still-developing market rather than exit early.

The supportive insole fits the firm’s tailored-solution positioning, and because it remained on the website in 2024 management would likely persist rather than write off the development effort too quickly.
The ergonomic safety shoe series had its own page in both years and is tightly aligned with the firm’s innovation agenda, making continued commitment very likely.
Firefighter and rescue boots gained their own page by 2024, signaling increased public commitment and suggesting management will keep backing this specialized protective-footwear extension.

The moulded insole stayed on the home page in both years and was supported by a specific customer reference, so management would see both visible commitment and early validation as reasons to continue.
